name: history-dot-com-json-server
description: Professional History.com application - Full-stack historical content management platform with React frontend and Express.js backend, featuring TypeScript, REST APIs, and enterprise-grade architecture.
author: mvdevelop

scripts.start: concurrently "cd frontend && npm run dev" "cd backend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check:frontend && npm run type-check:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:frontend && npm run test:coverage:backend
scripts.clean: npm run clean:frontend && npm run clean:backend
scripts.preinstall: node --version || echo 'Please install Node.js 18 or higher'
scripts.postinstall: echo 'History.com project dependencies installed successfully. Ready to develop!' && npm run prepare:all
scripts.prepare:all: cd frontend && npm run prepare && cd ../backend && npm run prepare
scripts.deploy: echo 'Deployment commands will be added. See README.md for deployment instructions.'
scripts.docs: echo 'Documentation commands will be implemented. See README.md for project documentation.'
scripts.security: echo 'Security audit commands: npm audit, npm audit fix'
scripts.performance: echo 'Performance analysis commands: npm run build:analyze in frontend and backend'

description: Professional History.com application - Full-stack historical content management platform with React frontend and Express.js backend, featuring TypeScript, REST APIs, and enterprise-grade architecture.
